scientific_integrity: The metric formulas and sharp constant are derived analytically for all permitted parameters. The bundled script independently checks the formulas by direct finite truncations on a deterministic grid; those computations are regression checks and are not used as substitutes for the infinite proof. Originality remains subject to the possibility of an older equivalent identity under discrete-Laplace or probability-metric terminology.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is restricted to centered symmetric geometric laws and moment budgets \(0<B\le1\). It does not remove the logarithmic factor for arbitrary discrete log-concave measures. For larger moment budgets, additional mass-crossing locations appear and the stated pairwise formula is not asserted.
title: A sharp log-free Lévy–Prokhorov/Wasserstein comparison for symmetric geometric laws
